name: youtube-ai-digest
description: Repository-embedded macOS skill for the local knowledge playlist workflow. Uses uv + uv.lock for reproducible Python environments, Brewfile for system dependencies, the YouTube Data API for strict playlist-added dates, Playwright-managed Chrome for cookies and browser fallback, and MLX Whisper plus Responses API for transcript summarization.
author: User
skill_scope: current-repo-first with adjacent local YouTube playlist summarization use cases

browser_runtime: Chrome CDP at 127.0.0.1:9222 for debug-only attach

boundaries.date_source: Prefer YouTube Data API playlistItems dates; only use first_seen fallback when explicitly requested.
boundaries.browser_role: Playwright handles cookies, managed profile, and page fallback; it is not the default Google login path.
boundaries.summary_failure_policy: Keep transcript outputs and mark pending_summary so summaries can be retried later.
